title: [Mar] Quick Hits — Defence exercises/platforms**: LAMITIYE-2026 (11th edn, India-Seychelles, biennial since 2001); NATO's Cold Response (Arctic, Norway/Finland, Arctic Sentry); INS Trikand (Mauritius 58th National Day, Talwar-class, Russia-built); P-8I/ADC-150 (DRDO-Navy indigenous 150kg Air Droppable Container trials); Exercise Sea Dragon 2026 (US-led, Guam; India/Japan/Australia/NZ); SAGAR 2nd edition (India's IOR maritime-security framework, 16 IONS nations, under MAHASAGAR vision); Exercise Amogh Jwala (Indian Army Southern Command, Babina); Exercise KAKADU 2026 (17th edn, Australia-led, India won Kakadu Shield Trophy); Prahar LMGs — Adani Defense delivered first batch of 2,000 to Army; Expedition Lokayan-26 (INS Sudarshini reached Sète, France).
